question: In May 2021, the International Olympic Committee named him/her as the athlete ambassador for its 'Believe in Sport' campaign aimed at preventing manipulation of the competition.
solution:
The correct answer is __PV Sindhu.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Shuttler PV Sindhu and Michelle Li from Canada have been appointed athlete ambassadors for the International Olympic Committee's (IOC) "Believe in Sport" campaign aimed at preventing competition manipulation, according to the Badminton World Federation.
 
• Sindhu and Li will collaborate with other athlete ambassadors from around the world to raise awareness and inspire athletes to avoid sport manipulation.
 
• Since April 2020, the duo has served as global ambassadors for the BWF's I am badminton" initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The IOC's "Believe in Sport" initiative was introduced in 2018 to raise awareness of the threat of competition manipulation among athletes, coaches, and officials. 
 
• Since April 2020, the duo has served as global ambassadors for the BWF's I am badminton" initiative.
 
• The Olympic Movement places a high emphasis on protecting honest athletes and keeping sport equal, and both the IOC and the BWF are committed to combating all types of cheating that essense sport's reputation and essence.
